name: Miramar (Spain)
description: Divided into three diagonal parts from the lower hoist to the upper fly: red at the hoist, yellow in the centre and black at the fly.
history: The official flag of Miramar is rectangular, of proportions three parts long by two wide, tierced per bend, the first third at the hoist gules, the second or central or, and the third at the fly sable; it was approved by resolution of 28 July 1992 of the Conseller of Public Administration and published in the DOGV of 3 September 1992. The arms had been approved by resolution of 26 February 1992.

features.role: broad diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
